nodes.name: Owner Notify Webhook
nodes.notes: Production URL: POST <n8n base>/webhook/owner-notify. Expected JSON body: {severity, code, message, meta}. Callers: agent-api/worker notify (NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL, ARCHITECTURE.md section 4), daily_ops IF-branch, health_alert forwarder. n8n webhooks carry no auth of their own -- keep this on the internal docker network or front it with the Cloudflare ingress worker's HMAC-validated /hook/* route (section 13).

nodes.name: Format Notification
nodes.notes: Defensive formatting: every field falls back to a safe default so a malformed or empty payload still produces a deliverable notification instead of a failed execution. meta is stringified and truncated to stay under Discord's 2000-char content limit.

string.name: text
string.value: ={{ '[' + (($json.body || {}).severity || 'info').toString().toUpperCase() + '] ' + (($json.body || {}).code || 'UNSPECIFIED') + ' -- ' + (($json.body || {}).message || 'No message provided (malformed or empty payload)') + '\nmeta: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.body || {}).meta || {}).slice(0, 1200) }}

nodes.name: Send Owner Notification (PLACEHOLDER)
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER notification transport -- point env OWNER_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL at YOUR channel and adjust the body to match: (1) Discord webhook: works as-is, body {content}. (2) Slack incoming webhook: change jsonBody to {text: $json.text}. (3) Telegram: URL https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage, body {chat_id, text: $json.text}. (4) Email/other: swap this node for the matching n8n node (e.g. emailSend) keeping the same input fields (severity, code, message, meta_json, text). onError=continue so a delivery failure still returns 200 to the caller; failed deliveries remain visible in n8n's execution list.
